lessons.error_signature: Gemini request failed 404 on gemini-2.5-flash / gemini-2.5-flash-lite
lessons.root_cause: normalizeGeminiModelName forcibly rewrote gemini-3.6-flash to deprecated gemini-2.5-flash, causing agent_runs #74-#78 to 404 in 70-141ms.
lessons.approved_fix: Stop downgrading configured model names, strip optional models/ prefixes, and honor explicit GEMINI_MODELS without forcing a default ahead of explicit env configuration.
lessons.regression_test: platform/test/llm-recovery.test.js (geminiModels deduplicates overlapping entries & respects explicit GEMINI_MODELS)

lessons.error_signature: Supabase Security Advisor 0015_rls_references_user_metadata & 22P02 invalid input syntax for type bigint
lessons.root_cause: RLS policies read end-user editable user_metadata and cast empty or non-numeric strings directly to ::bigint.
lessons.approved_fix: Read server-signed app_metadata only with a CASE regex guard (^[0-9]{1,18}$) before ::bigint cast, and revoke EXECUTE on SECURITY DEFINER functions from public, anon, and authenticated.

lessons.error_signature: ENOENT on ../../data_intake_kit during standalone Railway Railpack npm test
lessons.root_cause: Monorepo-only test file referencing sibling folder ../data_intake_kit was copied into the standalone deployment repository.
lessons.approved_fix: Keep monorepo-only intake seed tests out of the standalone platform deployment repo and always run npm run check && npm test && npm run build inside an isolated origin/main worktree before pushing.
lessons.regression_test: Clean origin/main worktree npm test gate (674/676 pass, 0 fail)

lessons.error_signature: LINE Rich Menu URI cross-LIFF spoofing, path traversal (/..), or orphan menu leak on PNG upload failure
lessons.root_cause: Allowing arbitrary liff.line.me paths or unpinned .neurohands.site subdomains and failing to DELETE created menus when content upload or DB save failed.
lessons.approved_fix: Pin allowedLiffId and tenant clientCode subdomain in setup-richmenu.js/line-console.js, reject empty URIs and .. segments, delete created menus on failure, restore prior default menu, and clean up superseded menus after sync.

lessons.error_signature: LINE webhook drops group join events and blocks all group/room messages
lessons.root_cause: handleEvent returned early when event.source.userId was absent (join events) and rejected all event.source.type !== 'user'.
lessons.approved_fix: Handle LINE group/room join, leave, bind <NH-CODE>, mention/keyword/always/off response policies, and per-thread human takeover states via line-group-router.js and conversation-handover.js.

lessons.error_signature: Wrong module import for isFreshRecord (catalog-access.js vs document-parser.js)
lessons.root_cause: workflow-runtime.js imported isFreshRecord from catalog-access.js instead of document-parser.js, caught immediately by U2 unit test.
lessons.approved_fix: Always read target module exports before importing; import isFreshRecord from ./document-parser.

lessons.error_signature: Fail-open handover/quota DB catch, cross-tenant LINE group re-bind hijack, and 0-charge quota_exceeded reset
lessons.root_cause: Caught during independent adversarial security review before release: non-missing-table DB errors fell through to AI, bind NH-CODE could overwrite another tenant's active group, and p_messages=0 could reset quota_exceeded to active.
lessons.approved_fix: Fail closed with C06_DATABASE_DEGRADED_RESPONSE on non-missing-table DB errors, block bind when group belongs to another active tenant, claim activation codes atomically via nh_claim_activation_code RPC, guard 0-charge quota resets, enforce owner_email uniqueness on trial signup, gate /api/trial/lessons, and suppress billing replies in public LINE groups.

lessons.error_signature: UI lessons lookup rendered empty Fix/Check text due to camelCase vs snake_case schema mismatch; new trial tenants lacked deterministic quote calculation from editable knowledge entries
lessons.root_cause: Frontend renderLessons read item.title/verifiedFix/regressionTest instead of DEV_LESSONS_LEDGER.json snake_case keys (error_signature/approved_fix/regression_test), and workflow-runtime.js only computed width*height quotes for glass_types rows.
lessons.approved_fix: Read snake_case lesson fields in renderLessons, add deterministic width*height pricing for custom knowledgeEntries in workflow-runtime.js, and verify full UI + API + PGlite PostgreSQL 17 RLS behavior across phone (390x844), tablet (768x1024), and laptop (1440x900) in scripts/verify-trial-pilot.mjs.

lessons.error_signature: LINE group approval reply exposed operator Approve/Reject buttons; 16:10 object-fit:cover cropped 1200x628 guide PNGs; mobile sticky header clipped #trial-workspace title
lessons.root_cause: Independent QA audit caught handleGroupEvent sending the operator approval Flex Card into customer groups, mismatched 16:10 vs 1200x628 (1.91:1) aspect ratios, and multi-line mobile sticky header taller than scroll-margin-top.
lessons.approved_fix: Split buildApprovalFlexCard into audience='customer' (no yes/no buttons, no numeric account ID) vs audience='operator' (1-tap yes/no for FOUNDER_LINE_ID only), align web .guide-media to 1200/628 object-fit:contain and LINE Flex hero to 191:100, compact mobile sticky header + set scroll-margin-top:148px, and hide fixed .mcta inside #trial-workspace.
